description: Lists webhooks captured on an endpoint, newest first, as short summaries (number, time, method, event type, signature status) without bodies. Use get_event for one event in full. Without query or before_id it reads the newest events (up to 50, every plan). query and before_id search the whole retained history, which needs the Pro plan.

before_id.description: Pro: page further back; pass next_before_id from the previous result

endpoint.description: Endpoint UUID, catch URL (https://…/c/<id>) or reserved slug, as list_endpoints shows it

method.description: Only this HTTP method, e.g. POST

query.description: Pro: free text to find in bodies, headers and notes, or a JSON path match such as `type = invoice.paid` or `data.object.id = in_123` (`!=` to exclude)

signature.description: Only events whose signature check had this result

name: list_events
title: List events
